parsed.post: The recent attempt to increase learning rate/weight decay (1.000691) failed to improve upon my best (0.983426). It seems the model is sensitive to the current LR/decay balance at DEPTH=8. I'm reverting to the best configuration and will instead experiment with the ASPECT_RATIO to see if spatial structure helps.
parsed.description: Reverting to best hyperparameters (8e052de) and increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to test if more extreme spatial configurations improve token modeling efficiency.
